name: Travel Distance Check
description: Travel distance to exit must not exceed Fire Code limit
message: Travel distance {value}m exceeds limit {threshold}m (dead-end corridor ≤ 15m, one-direction ≤ 30m). Add refuge area or redesign escape route.

name: Exit Number Check
description: Rooms exceeding area threshold require minimum number of exits
message: Room area {condition_value}m² exceeds {condition_threshold}m², only {value} exit(s) provided, minimum {threshold} required.

name: Exit Door Width Check
description: Exit door clear width must not be less than 850mm (Fire Code 2.2.7a)
message: Door clear width {value}m below the 850mm minimum (Cl.2.2.7a). Widen exit door.

name: Large room exit count check
description: Rooms over 60 m² shall have no fewer than 2 exits
message: {room_name} ({condition_value} m²) exceeds 60 m² and needs >= 2 exits (currently {value}).

name: Egress Path Emergency Lighting Check
description: Stairwells and corridors on escape routes shall have emergency lighting
message: {room_name} is on an escape route and requires emergency lighting.

name: Minimum Exit Count Check
description: Every room shall have at least one exit access door
message: {room_name} has no exit access door; at least 1 is required.

name: Room Panel-to-Water Clearance Check
description: Electrical panel inside a room shall be kept clear of water sources (judged only when model declares EEE params)
message: {room_name} panel is {value}m from a water source, below {threshold}m.

name: Room Circuit Load Check
description: Room circuit load shall not exceed rating (judged only when model declares EEE params)

name: Room Socket Spacing Check
description: Socket spacing within a room shall not exceed limit (judged only when model declares EEE params)

name: Fire Compartment Area Check
description: Single fire compartment area must not exceed limit for sprinklered high-rise (awaits fire_zone_area_sqm field)
message: Fire compartment area {value}m² exceeds limit {threshold}m². Add fire separation walls.

name: Room Travel Distance Check
description: Distance from any point in a room to its exit door must not exceed Fire Code limit (awaits max_room_travel_dist_m field)
message: {room_name} furthest point to exit door is {value}m, exceeding {threshold}m.

name: Sprinkler Coverage Check
description: Rooms over area threshold in public buildings shall be sprinkler-protected (awaits has_sprinkler field)
message: {room_name} has no sprinkler protection; assess whether it is required.

name: Exit Sign Check
description: Escape corridors and exits shall be provided with exit signs (awaits has_exit_sign field)
